tests.command: xperl-install install GraphQL with this registry

failure: Two kinds of failure on XPerl, none on Perl 5.44. (1) GraphQL::Subscription rethrows a caught error with die $@, and GraphQL::Error->coerce stringifies it into the client-visible error message, which then ended with "\t...propagated at <server path>/GraphQL/Subscription.pm line 116." (t/subscribe.t line 218). (2) The test helper promise_test compares $@ exactly, and the test FakePromise rethrows with die @values (t/perl.t lines 524 and 526, t/subscribe.t line 319). The patch makes coerce use the text ordinary Perl would produce for an exception that, apart from rethrow context, is a single ERROR_USER_TEXT diagnostic, and lets promise_test accept trailing propagation lines after the complete expected message. A wrong or missing expected error still fails.
